posts.title: Day 281: Not My Landscape Edit
posts.description: This landscape photo was edited by someone else I know, changing the hue and saturation of the image. It revealed some instinctual habits of my own.

posts.title: Day 280: City Spirit
posts.description: Participants of a Philadelphia run event across the Benjamin Franklin bridge waved for my street photography.

posts.title: Day 279: Cards and Discs
posts.description: A station of gadgets to load cassettes and record media. In the corner of a repurposed building, I went with other artists to observe this space.
